consumer_local_binding.absolute_path_rule: Canonical absolute paths are required and bound to the validated launcher identity.
consumer_local_binding.json_fields: The provider_root, provider_launcher, consumer_project and consumer_git_root values in <provider-id>/runtime/provider.env.
consumer_local_binding.portability: provider.env and its entry are ignored local runtime artifacts, not portable identity and not transferable between hosts. Recreate them with prepare on the destination host.

domain_provider_route_and_endconsumer_bo.absolute_path_rule: Canonical absolute paths are required so PP can enforce the exact executable, project and Git-root boundary without discovery or repair.
domain_provider_route_and_endconsumer_bo.portability: These fields are a host-local invocation envelope, not portable contract or state data.

host_local_result_projections.absolute_path_rule: Absolute paths are allowed because they locate the objects used by that invocation.
host_local_result_projections.json_fields: The route, boundary and state-file locations in status or acknowledge.status, any path in diagnostic error, and entry plus provider_env in prepare.
host_local_result_projections.portability: Results are local observations. Do not persist or relay these locators as portable identity, contract or lifecycle state.

portable_contract_and_state.absolute_path_rule: Filesystem locations are safe relative values where the schema defines a path; canonical host-absolute filesystem paths are forbidden. Registration and acknowledgement contain only exact version and commit.
portable_contract_and_state.json_fields: subject.documentation, release documentation, consumer.state selectors, registration/acknowledgement identity JSON and adoption mode.
portable_contract_and_state.portability: These values are independent of a host route. Opaque context references remain provider-owned; the domain provider must keep its typed portable references free of host-local absolute filesystem paths. PP does not reinterpret their Fach meaning.

pp_invocation_route.absolute_path_rule: One canonical absolute host-local root is required. The paired provider_launcher remains the relative bin/provider-provider; a second absolute PP launcher is forbidden.
pp_invocation_route.json_fields: The provider_root field from provider --json and the provider.provider_root field from catalog --json.
pp_invocation_route.portability: Version plus commit is the portable PP identity. The root is only its local invocation anchor and is rebound per host.
